events.verdict: Reid (MIN) directly contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Gilgeous-Alexander's hand after the release.
Wallace (OKC) firms up to his left shoulder in McDaniels' (MIN) path and does not deliver contact.
Dort (OKC) keeps both feet in bounds before as he receives the pass to start his upward shooting motion.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) brushes and makes marginal contact DiVincenzo's (MIN) arm as he pursues the rebound.
Dort (OKC) helps at the end of the drive and it is unclear if he swipes down and makes contact with McDaniels' (MIN) head.
Randle (MIN) makes contact with Holmgren's (OKC) head, which causes him to stumble as he gets control of the rebound.
Holmgren (OKC) and Randle (MIN) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Dort (OKC) brings his left arm around Randle's (MIN) waist, which affects his FOM off-ball.
Dort's (OKC) foot is across the 3pt line while Randle (MIN) attempts and releases his free throw.
Edwards (MIN) brings his right hand forward and cleanly blocks Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) shot attempt.
Williams (OKC) commits a take foul on Randle (MIN).
Edwards (MIN) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) as the steal occurs.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) commits a take foul on McDaniels (MIN).
